Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir words, no lead melody that competes with a male narrator; keep the 1-4 kHz range sparse; no ukulele, no steel guitar, no tiki or luau cliches; clean ending without a fade-out tail

cues.prompt: Begins instantly, with no intro, on a massive fortissimo orchestral downbeat on the very first beat: full orchestra tutti, timpani and low brass, a huge wide D major chord. About four seconds later a second, even bigger swell of brass and strings rises to a majestic peak and holds. About thirteen seconds in it drops suddenly to pianissimo: a solo felt piano and a very soft sustained string pad, still and reflective, quiet to the end. No fade-in, no riser, no stinger tail, no drum fills.

cues.prompt: Cold open of a wonder documentary in D Lydian at 96 bpm. From the first beat to about 10 s: an airy, curious pulse, felt piano and soft synth arpeggios, light and bright, mezzo-piano. From about 10 s: low strings and a deep pulse build steadily to forte, a big warm open arrival chord at about 17 s and a bright full bloom at about 19 s, the loudest moment of the cue. From about 20 s: a sudden drop to piano, sparse and light, only plucked notes and a soft pad. From about 27 s: the pulse drops an octave into something deep and mysterious, mezzo-piano, with a simple three-note descending felt-piano figure (the look-down motif) at about 29 s and a held unresolved chord at about 33 s. From about 44 s: a slow rising swell to mezzo-forte, then at about 50 s it thins to a single soft sustained pad, pianissimo, to the end. No intro sting, no big drums.

Reprise of the cold-open theme in D Lydian at 96 bpm: the same airy, curious pulse with felt piano and soft synth arpeggios. From the first beat to about 15 s: full, warm and swelling with rising water, forte, the theme at its fullest and widest with low strings. At about 15 s it drops to mezzo-piano, gentle and settled, sparse felt piano and pad; a simple three-note descending felt-piano figure (the look-down motif) once at about 27 s; at about 30 s a short curious lift like a question; from about 36 s a final warm phrase, mezzo-piano, landing gently on a single sustained felt-piano note at about 46 s that decays to silence by about 48 s.

A travelling documentary cue in G major at 100 bpm. From the first beat to about 9 s: muted plucked arpeggios, a soft kick pulse, shaker and warm strings, a steady sense of a journey across millions of years, mezzo-forte. From about 9 s: it drops to piano, restrained and reflective, only a soft pad and sparse felt piano, no percussion. From about 22 s: forward motion returns, mezzo-forte, with a gentle lift at about 25 s, another at about 28 s and a bigger one at about 36 s, the fullest part of the cue. From about 42 s: the texture thins to piano, open and wind-like, smaller and lower, with one soft low accent at about 49 s, and it resolves quietly at about 57 s.

A bright, open documentary cue in A major at 108 bpm. From the first beat to about 12 s: light mallets and plucked strings, a little mischievous, mezzo-forte. From about 12.5 s: it drops to piano, a graceful legato phrase on soft strings that trips with a playful hiccup at about 16 s, sparse. From about 20 s: deeper and rising with wonder, a crescendo to forte, a broad low chord with low strings and a brass-like synth at about 25 s, the loudest part of the cue. From about 30 s: mezzo-forte, curious and intelligent with a steady pulse and a driving mechanical undertone, building to a firm, clean final stop at about 43 s.

A low, respectful documentary pad in D minor, very slow. From the start to about 41 s: pianissimo and completely still, one long sustained low string pad with quiet aquatic low drones, no melody, no percussion, no new entries, no swells and no accents, settling on a single held low note from about 27 s. From about 41.5 s: a gentle lift into reflective wonder, piano, soft felt piano and pads in F major with a slow pulse. From about 54 s: mezzo-forte, darker and inevitable, a slow marching low pulse, descending. From about 71 s: a brief hopeful rising phrase, mezzo-forte, resolving on a warm chord at about 77 s.

Light, classy, playful documentary underscore in G major at 104 bpm. From the first beat to about 11.5 s: bouncy pizzicato strings, nylon-guitar harmonics, a light shaker and an airy flute-like synth, mezzo-piano, with breezy space between phrases; the phrase ends cleanly at about 11.8 s, then a short breath. From about 12 s: the bounce is gone, a soft pad only. At about 15.5 s wide sustained legato strings open up in awe with a crescendo to forte. At about 19.5 s it darkens into a quiet low suspended string chord, held, piano.
